info.title: Revenue reporting — which table to trust

contents.text:
Findings from the Finance domain review.

Use fct_users_created as the canonical signup fact table — it is the only Finance-domain table with an owner and a maintained schema. fct_users_deleted mirrors its grain and joins on user_id.

Do NOT use logging_events for revenue reporting: it sits in the Marketing domain and carries a PII classification, so cards scoped to Finance cannot read it.
